title: A New Coat Every Year
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Samuel was a little boy,
His mother kept her word.
She brought him to the temple, where
God's voice would soon be heard.

[Chorus]
Be brave when God asks something hard,
Like Samuel, small and true.
You do not have to feel so big,
The Lord will help you through.

[Verse 2]
"This is the son I prayed for, Lord,
I give him back to You."
Each year she brought a brand-new coat,
And Samuel grew and grew.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now snuggle in your cozy bed,
And close your sleepy eyes.
Like Hannah's coat, God wraps you warm,
Until the sun shall rise.

[Chorus]
mood: Steady music. A calm, even pulse walks under the voice, firm and reassuring, like a small boy taking brave steps toward a big doorway with his mother's hand on his shoulder. The first verses keep a quiet forward motion that feels safe rather than sad. By the last verse the pulse slows and drops lower, wrapping around the melody like a warm coat until it comes to rest.
